name: 692-b32d-quiet
notes: B32.d: after a death (the box remembers its dead on the tree): the mourner walks alone from the fire, head down; the fire turns to watch; looks up; a hand on the bark (the glow comes up); sits against the trunk, a leaf on the shoulder; ties the charm on tiptoe; looks up; walks back and is met with a hug. (The view clock is paused at dusk for the clip: a fresh camp pitches its tents and goes to bed in the next hour.)
